author: chaibrit1
body:
This Red Alert map is called "Gapple Run!" made by FrostedCupcakez, SomeonedoesMC, and myself (bpirr). This is also the first map we have ever made together :D and feedback is always appreciated, enjoy!

Album~http://imgur.com/a/Uhkjg/all
YAML~http://www.mediafire.com/view/py1d7pbdz5dkb2p/Red_Alert_Gapple_Run_YAML.rtf (Contact FrostedCupcakez if there are concerns with the YAML)
Download~http://www.mediafire.com/download/fro7b90rhf95a3o/RedAlertApples.rar
creds to alexanderjoe10 for the download and build server!
